KARNATAKA ACT NO. 28 OF 2011
THE KARNATAKA RENT (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2008
STATEMENT OF OBJECTS AND REASONS
Amending Act 28 of 2011.- In view of the observations of Supreme Court in B.P. Achala Anand Vs.S.
Appi Reddy and another reported in ILR 2005 KAR 1721, it is considered necessary to amend the
Karnataka Rent Act, 1999 to provide for tenancy right in respect of a deserted wife of a tenant, who has
been or is entitled to be in occupation of the matrimonial home or tenanted premises of husband and a
divorced wife of a tenant, who has a decree of divorce in which the right of residence in the matrimonial
home or tenanted premises has been incorporated as one of the conditions of the decree of divorce.
Hence the Bill.
[L.A. Bill No. 8 of 2008, File No.Samvyashae 10 Shasana 2007]

KARNATAKA ACT NO. 28 OF 2011
(First published in the Karnataka Gazette Extra-ordinary on the Twenty second day of June 2011)
THE KARNATAKA RENT (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2008
(Received the assent of the President on the tenth day of June, 2011)
An Act further to amend the Karnataka Rent Act, 1999.
Whereas it is expedient further to amend the Karnataka Rent Act, 1999 (Karnataka Act 34 of 2001) for
the purposes hereinafter appearing;
Be it enacted by the Karnataka State Legislature in the fifty-ninth year of the Republic of India, as
follows: -
title: Karnataka Rent (Amendment) Act, 2008

publisher: Department of Parliamentary Affairs and Legislation
text:
(1) This Act may be called the Karnataka Rent (Amendment) Act,
2008.
(2) It shall come into force at once.
title: Karnataka Rent (Amendment) Act, 2008

publisher: Department of Parliamentary Affairs and Legislation
text:
In the Karnataka Rent Act, 1999 (Karnataka Act 34 of 2001), in
section 3, in clause (n), after item (ii), the following shall be inserted, namely:-
"(iii) A deserted wife of a tenant who has been or is entitled to be in occupation of the matrimonial home or
tenanted premises of husband; and
(iv) a divorced wife of a tenant who has a decree of divorce in which the right of residence in the
matrimonial home or tenanted premises has been incorporated as one of the conditions of the decree of
divorce."
